content: The Presence STAND ALONE .  Creekside was a sleepy picturesque town in South Carolina, Nestled an hour from the city of Columbia it was a great place to live and  then. The night the lights came, one stormy night bright lights lit the horizon, Over the next few days strange things began to  occur,  and people began to act differently.  A Creature has invaded the small town, one who has the ability to infect and take control of those its touches soon things in the town turn from bad to worse as the creature begins to gain more control and its plans  to take not only the town but the state then the country then the world began to come to light. With the help of an old Vietnam vet, a crazy homeless man and two local kids Mayor Kelly has to stop this before it can leave the small town and take over the world.    Kelly Moss Mayor  Creekside SC Kelly Moss was the first elected female  in  the office of Mayor for the small southern town of Creekside, boasting a population of 2500 it was a rural junction where very little ever happened,  She  is a capable and intelligent strong woman, now divorced and on her own .
